relationships.subject: methanandamide
relationships.evidence_quote: A stable analogue of anandamide, methanandamide (mAEA) evoked initial excitatory response of mucosal afferents followed by potentiation of their responses to mechanical stimulation.

relationships.subject: 2-AG
relationships.evidence_quote: 2-AG application evoked a brief excitation of mucosal afferents, without potentiation of their mechanosensitivity, followed by the inhibition of their responses to mechanical stimulation.

relationships.subject: 2-AG
relationships.evidence_quote: CB2 receptor antagonist, SR144528 abolished the inhibitory effect of 2-AG.

key_findings: mAEA potentiated while 2-AG inhibited mechanosensitivity of mucosal capsaicin-sensitive bladder afferents in guinea pig.
mAEA's inhibitory effect (when TRPV1 blocked) required CB1 and CB2; 2-AG's inhibition was CB2-dependent.
